english.note: Use this when a general account gives only the main points and leaves out minor details.
Use this for an approximate, preliminary, or hastily prepared version or estimate.

examples.english: We only gave a general introduction to the plan.
examples.traditional: 我哋只係粗略咁介紹咗個計劃。
